# A function a test hands its instance to is inlined into the test, so what
# cannot be inlined is refused where it is called, on every compiled target:
# a return from the middle, a call of itself, a value it does more than
# return. A local holding the instance is replaced by it, so one assigned
# again is refused too, and so is one whose copy an index that may change
# chooses. The interpreter answers each, being the reference.

! sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go mid_return.sngl
stderr 'mid_return.sngl:29:5: `clickK` is handed the test''s instance, so it is inlined into the test, and cannot return from the middle'

! sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go recursive.sngl
stderr 'recursive.sngl:20:9: `again` is handed the test''s instance and calls itself'

! sngl test --platform=html value_block.sngl
stderr 'value_block.sngl:26:14: `shown` is handed the test''s instance, so it is inlined into the test, and is called for a value it does more than return'

! sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go reassigned.sngl
stderr 'reassigned.sngl:20:5: `held` holds the test''s instance and is assigned again'

! sngl test --platform=html alias_index.sngl
stderr 'alias_index.sngl:20:19: `r` holds a copy of the test''s instance chosen by an index that is not a constant'

sngl test --platform=none mid_return.sngl
stdout 'ok   1 tests, 0 failures'

-- mid_return.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        if shown {
            button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        }
    }
}

window {
    main
}

func clickK(c main) {
    if c.k == null {
        return
    }
    t2(c)
}

func t2(c main) {
}

func testMid(t Test, c main) {
    clickK(c)
}
-- recursive.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        if shown {
            button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        }
    }
}

window {
    main
}

func again(c main, n int) {
    if n > 0 {
        again(c, n - 1)
    }
}

func testRec(t Test, c main) {
    again(c, 2)
}
-- reassigned.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        if shown {
            button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        }
    }
}

window {
    main
}

func testHeld(t Test, c main) {
    var held = c
    held = c
    t.assert(held.k != null)
}
-- value_block.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component main node {
    var hits = 0
    var shown = true
    vbox {
        if shown {
            button #k(text="k{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
        }
    }
}

window {
    main
}

func shown(c main) bool {
    if c.k != null {
        return true
    }
    return false
}

func testValue(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(shown(c))
}
-- alias_index.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component item(label string) node {
    var hits = 0
    button #hit(text="{label}{hits}", @click { hits = hits + 1 })
}

component main node {
    var xs = ["a", "b"]
    vbox {
        for var x = xs {
            item #row(label=x)
        }
    }
}

func testAliasIndex(t Test, c main) {
    var i = 0
    var r = c.row[i]
    i = 1
    r.hit.click()
    t.assert(c.row[0].hits == 1)
    t.assert(c.row[1].hits == 0)
}

window {
    main
}
